routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Red Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description: An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to ~mission(Location|Address) as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s ~mission(Objects) and of their ships that may need assistance. This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Take Headhunter Stronghold Offline
routes.description:
With the recent aggression perpetrated by the Headhunters against our people, Citizens for Prosperity has been arranging a full operation that should hopefully deal them a significant blow. 

However, before that can happen, we need to by some more time to finish our preparations. If you could destroy the power generators at ~mission(Location|Address) it should stall the Headhunters long enough for us to ready our counter attack. 

Your assistance will be critical to our success,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eliminate Fuel Stores
routes.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Halt Narcotics Operation
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eradicate All Traces of Headhunter Data
routes.description:
We're just putting the full picture together now, but so far we've learned that a Headhunter by the name of ~mission(TargetName) recently stole some sensitive data that if exposed will be detrimental to Citizens for Prosperity's cause. 

We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at ~mission(Location|Address) as well as tracking down ~mission(TargetName|Last) to stop them from further disseminating the information.

Your help is much appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Adagio Holdings: Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers
routes.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF:

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Clear Outlaw Data Center
routes.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.description:

To accomplish this, they have been using intel gathered on us that is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address). By destroying these servers and the information they contain, we should be able to significantly hamper the Headhunters' ability to move against us.

Thanks for the assistance,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at ~mission(Location|Address) and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eliminate Fuel Stores
routes.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Halt Narcotics Operation
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Limit Outlaw Operational Capacity
routes.description:
There is a band of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) who have increasingly become an issue for Citizens for Prosperity settlements in the sector.

While direct violence against the perpetrators would potentially be effective, it is not in the spirit of our mission here. Instead, we would like you to take the generators near their stronghold offline. This should limit their operational capacity while hopefully preserving life. 

I like to think that today's outlaws are tomorrow's productive members of society.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Take Outlaws at ~mission(Location) Offline
routes.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
routes.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at ~mission(Location|Address) our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Assistance Needed Against XenoThreat Raid
routes.description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at ~mission(Location|Address) first before heading to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at ~mission(Location|Address) and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eliminate Fuel Stores
routes.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Halt Narcotics Operation
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Limit Outlaw Operational Capacity
routes.description:
There is a band of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) who have increasingly become an issue for Citizens for Prosperity settlements in the sector.

While direct violence against the perpetrators would potentially be effective, it is not in the spirit of our mission here. Instead, we would like you to take the generators near their stronghold offline. This should limit their operational capacity while hopefully preserving life. 

I like to think that today's outlaws are tomorrow's productive members of society.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Take Outlaws at ~mission(Location) Offline
routes.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
routes.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at ~mission(Location|Address) our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Assistance Needed Against XenoThreat Raid
routes.description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at ~mission(Location|Address) first before heading to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Clear Outlaw Data Center
routes.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Wipe Headhunter Data Servers
routes.description:
With increasing frequency, members of the Headhunters gang have been targeting Citizens for Prosperity settlements when our patrols are too far to offer assistance. 

To accomplish this, they have been using intel gathered on us that is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address). By destroying these servers and the information they contain, we should be able to significantly hamper the Headhunters' ability to move against us.

Thanks for the assistance,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eliminate Fuel Stores
routes.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Halt Narcotics Operation
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Limit Outlaw Operational Capacity
routes.description:
There is a band of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) who have increasingly become an issue for Citizens for Prosperity settlements in the sector.

While direct violence against the perpetrators would potentially be effective, it is not in the spirit of our mission here. Instead, we would like you to take the generators near their stronghold offline. This should limit their operational capacity while hopefully preserving life. 

I like to think that today's outlaws are tomorrow's productive members of society.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Take Outlaws at ~mission(Location) Offline
routes.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
routes.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at ~mission(Location|Address) our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Assistance Needed Against XenoThreat Raid
routes.description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at ~mission(Location|Address) first before heading to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Clear Outlaw Data Center
routes.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

routes.mission_name: FTL Courier: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN NYX
routes.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
FTL requires an entry-level courier to complete deliveries in Nyx.
Courier must provide own transportation.
Prior training in manual lifting is preferred, with the <EM4>ability to move boxes of up to .25 SCU</EM4> in weight.
By accepting this contract you agree to take full responsibility for the safety of the assigned packages.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

routes.mission_name: FTL Courier: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
routes.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the <EM4>ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes</EM4>.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

routes.mission_name: FTL Courier: JR. LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
routes.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be <EM4>required to lift up to .25 SCU</EM4> in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Level Contract: Clear Shipjacking Group
routes.description:
There's a small group of criminals that have been marking their territory, striking out any freighters that get close enough. They got a little too greedy though, because now someone's paying us to go deal with them.

Once you and whoever you're bringing are ready, go to ~mission(Location|Address) and engage with these criminals. Since they like to fly in separate packs, be sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.
 
Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Level Contract: Neutralize Shipjacking Gang
routes.description:
Okay, this might be a bit of stretch to do on your own, so if you got any favors to call in, it could be good to cash those chits now. There's a group of desperados striking delivery ships up and down this sector and we've been tasked with cleaning them up. 

Once your crew is ready, head over to ~mission(Location|Address) and take the hostiles there down. Now, these bastards are a bit clever so they tend to split up into smaller packs. Make sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.
 
Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives."

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Defend ~mission(Objects)
routes.description:
Calling all pilots – one of our clients is looking for some protection for their <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4>, based in <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. From what we’ve gathered, the attackers are a group of wannabe outlaw pests who probably haven’t realized the value of the assets they’re trying to destroy, just wreaking havoc for the sake of it. Still, the client’s property is important, so should be kept as intact as possible.

If you take care of them to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects)
routes.description:
Any willing pilots in the area? Need some protection around <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> for a client. A band of outlaws has been targeting their <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4>, and if nothing's done about it they'll do some real damage. Need someone to protect the client’s property as much as possible and deal with the thugs.

From the intel we’ve managed to gather, these thugs are small-time but can cause some pain if you’re not careful. So, if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

Need someone to knock out a security patrol. You’ll need to go to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and then scan several designated waypoints ensuring that they’re safe and secure. 

Satellites in that region have been acting up recently. Not exactly sure what’s going on out there, but best be prepared in case there’s any trouble.

Complete this contract and the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.</EM4>

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Orange Level Contract: Security Patrol
routes.description:
A client is concerned about activity near some of their interests. We’ve been contracted to patrol the area and run scans at several locations. Interested? If so, head to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD to start the patrol.

The client wasn’t specific about the threats, but they don’t think everything’s on the level out there. Hopefully we’ll be able to bring them some peace of mind.

Additionally, the client arranged for us to offer a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor.


Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Orange Level Contract: Potential Security Threat
routes.description:
Several unknown ships have been spotted in areas frequented by haulers delivering goods for our client. They’re worried these ships are monitoring their haulers in preparation for an ambush, so they’ve hired us to patrol the area. 

Start by going to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scan it to ensure it’s clear. After that, we’ll send you to some other areas to scan for potential threats. We recommend that you bring a <EM4>wingman</EM4> and plenty of supplies to be ready to handle whatever might come your way.     

Also know that successfully completing this contract will earn the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.</EM4>

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Red Level Contract: High-Risk Security Patrol
routes.description:
A client needs our help. Outlaws are roaming certain sectors where they do business and attacking anyone they come across. Our client has already lost several ships and can’t afford to lose anymore. 

We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan. 

From the sound of it, these packs of ships feature skilled and aggressive pilots. Best be ready to rumble if you run into any of them. Would be good to have at least <EM4>two trusted pilots</EM4> by your side for this one.

At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip.</EM4>

Stay chilly,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Red Level Contract: Secure Threatened Space
routes.description:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least <EM4>three friends</EM4> to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.   

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

For the hustle and effort, we’ll also be paying a bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor for dealing with this.

The situation is evolving, but I’m being fed constant updates on what’s going on and will keep you informed as the contract progresses. 

Are you available to come to their aid? Would be smart to recruit some friends to help. These are important clients and we can’t afford to fail them. The main contractor will earn a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> if you get the job done.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

routes.description:
We’ve got clients reporting outlaw attacks on ships around <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4>. They got locked down tight and anybody heading in or out is a target. Any attempts to solve the issue have just been met with more outlaw reinforcements appearing. 

The client is desperate for a solution, so we’re hiring a contractor to go and restore peace in the area. If any other issues flare up once you're there, I’ll comm you directions on how to help.  

Really need someone on this fast. So to sweeten the pot, the main contractor will also get a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton

Looking for someone who can grab their gear, a few support ships they can trust, and deploy before it’s too late. Once you arrive, I’ll send any sitrep updates your way.  

Don’t mess this up. These clients are paying for and expecting top tier protection. If anything goes wrong, we could lose this contract. That’s why we’ll give the main contractor a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> if all goes down without a hitch.

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

routes.description:
Looking for a consummate professional to handle a high-stakes job. We’ve got VIP clients at <EM4>~mission(DefendLocationWrapperLocation|Address)</EM4> who are facing extremely aggressive and motivated outlaws targeting ships around their location. Exact details on the attack are still rolling in, but it appears to be a wide ranging, multi-pronged operation. 

If you’re available, I highly recommend that you bring additional combat support ships, plenty of supplies, and your A-game. Get this right, and we’ll reward the main contractor with a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

Good luck,

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: Med. Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
routes.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>~mission(System) </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

~mission(Hint_Location) For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>~mission(Hint_Tool)</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a tip about <EM4>a ship that had been attacked at ~mission(Location)</EM4>.  Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there. 

We're looking for someone to go out, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and bring it to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> so we can figure out what happened. 

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF: 
There's been another attack out at ~mission(Location). Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and deliver it ~mission(Destination)</EM4>. Make sure you <EM4>bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox</EM4>.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet <EM4>they're still in the area</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger

WORK BRIEF: 
We had another ship attacked out near ~mission(Location) and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and <EM4>retrieve the blackbox</EM4>. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage.</EM4>

Just be careful, there's a real good chance <EM4>the ambushers are still there waiting</EM4> for someone to claim it.

If you're able to get it, <EM4>deliver the blackbox to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Efficient Miners Wanted
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Efficient Miners Wanted

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with something. If you could harvest ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4>, that would really help out our understanding of the current mineral levels in the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: High Priority Ore Scan
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Priority Ore Scan

WORK BRIEF: 
I'm looking for people to go out and find deposits of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4> to contribute to a system-wide experiment that will help plan future mining operations. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Hope I can rely on you.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with a prospecting job. Need someone to track down a deposit of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4>. 
This data will be helpful for some studies we're doing about mineral levels. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Mining and Data Collection
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining and Data Collection

WORK BRIEF: 
Have a big one for you today. Need you to get down there and mine ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4> and relay your stats back to us. I'm looking to pull together some findings from various miners around the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Missing Persons
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Persons

WORK BRIEF: 
A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.

I'll send you <EM4>their last known location</EM4>. Just head out there and see what happened.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Moraine Movements
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Movements

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but <EM4>it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there</EM4>, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Large
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Large Ship Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Word got passed over that <EM4>there's a large derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>, so we're putting the word out for anyone who's got the ships and gear to break it down. 

If you can chop it up, then <EM4>deliver the resources to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll pay you for your time.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Mid
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Medium Ship Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got word that a ship got destroyed out by ~mission(Location) after an ambush. Owner is willing to pay for someone to go salvage the parts and <EM4>bring them to ~mission(Destination)</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Small
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a call about <EM4>a derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>. Ran the regtag through the system to make sure we weren't taking someone's ride but it looks unclaimed, so I need someone with a salvage ship to head out and break it down. 

Once you're done, <EM4>take the resources to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|RecoverItemTitle)
routes.description:

Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
