This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleSuper)
routes.description:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>, we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleIntro)
routes.description:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that we want.

All you have to do is take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleVeryEasy)
routes.description:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>.

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleEasy)
routes.description:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleMedium)
routes.description:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleHard)
routes.description:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> for us. 

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleVeryHard)
routes.description:

routes.mission_name: Vaughn: A Challenging Contract
routes.description:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

routes.mission_name: Vaughn: All Things Come To An End
routes.description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to ~mission(Location|Address) and kill ~mission(TargetName). What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

routes.mission_name: Covalex: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
routes.description:
Hi, 

Several Citizens for Prosperity outposts in Pyro need supplies. It seems like we regularly do runs like this for them, but this one looks like it might be a bit riskier. A CFP rep let me know that outlaw activity around these sites has spiked recently, but they desperately need these outposts restocked, so we’re going ahead with the delivery. <EM4>Just a head’s up that you could run into trouble, so come prepared</EM4>.       

All the cargo’s waiting at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and here’s where it’s heading:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)  

According to the manifest, the largest cargo container you’ll need to deal with is <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>. Aside from that, remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.    

~mission(Contractor|SignOff) 
  
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

routes.mission_name: Covalex: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - Direct ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
routes.description:
Hiya, 

Looking for a hauler willing to make a run to Ruin Station. Know hauls to Pyro can give some people pause, but this is one we do regularly to help supply the station. I’ve also confirmed that everything on the cargo manifest is above board. 

If you’re interested, the cargo is ready for pick up at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  Make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Clear Outlaw Data Center
routes.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Wipe Headhunter Data Servers
routes.description:
With increasing frequency, members of the Headhunters gang have been targeting Citizens for Prosperity settlements when our patrols are too far to offer assistance. 

To accomplish this, they have been using intel gathered on us that is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address). By destroying these servers and the information they contain, we should be able to significantly hamper the Headhunters' ability to move against us.

Thanks for the assistance,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at ~mission(Location|Address) and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eliminate Fuel Stores
routes.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Halt Narcotics Operation
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Limit Outlaw Operational Capacity
routes.description:
There is a band of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) who have increasingly become an issue for Citizens for Prosperity settlements in the sector.

While direct violence against the perpetrators would potentially be effective, it is not in the spirit of our mission here. Instead, we would like you to take the generators near their stronghold offline. This should limit their operational capacity while hopefully preserving life. 

I like to think that today's outlaws are tomorrow's productive members of society.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Take Outlaws at ~mission(Location) Offline
routes.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
routes.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at ~mission(Location|Address) our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Assistance Needed Against XenoThreat Raid
routes.description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at ~mission(Location|Address) first before heading to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Ling Family Hauling: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
routes.description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

routes.mission_name: Ling Family Hauling: Ling Family ~mission(ReputationRank) Cargo Haul - ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Scale
routes.description:
Hi, 

Guess the folks at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:  

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(MultiToSingleToken)     

Please remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>.  

  
Happy Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

routes.mission_name: Northrock Service Group: Bounty Assignment: ~mission(TargetName) (HRT)
routes.description:
Hey, 

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name ~mission(TargetName) has been located at ~mission(Location|Address). 

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out. 

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick. 

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
routes.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> is in need of ~mission(FuelType), so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
routes.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting ~mission(FuelType). Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: URGENT REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
routes.description:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use ~mission(FuelType). If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there. 

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Hockrow Agency: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
routes.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

routes.mission_name: Ling Family Hauling: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
routes.description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

routes.mission_name: Ling Family Hauling: Ling Family ~mission(ReputationRank) Cargo Haul - ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Scale
routes.description:
Hi, 

Guess the folks at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:  

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(MultiToSingleToken)     

Please remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>.  

  
Happy Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling







Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Return of XenoThreat — 18,000 pts
routes.description:
The terrorist group XenoThreat have returned to Stanton seeking to violently impose their intolerant values on the system. Their well-armed members are harassing not only the alien residents, but anyone they have deemed a traitor to Humanity, specifically Human pilots of alien-made spacecraft.

It is clear that they will not stop attempting to spread their hatred unless we stop them.

Join us. Do your part.

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Clear Outlaw Data Center
routes.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at ~mission(Location|Address) and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans. 

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eliminate Fuel Stores
routes.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Halt Narcotics Operation
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Limit Outlaw Operational Capacity
routes.description:
There is a band of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) who have increasingly become an issue for Citizens for Prosperity settlements in the sector.

While direct violence against the perpetrators would potentially be effective, it is not in the spirit of our mission here. Instead, we would like you to take the generators near their stronghold offline. This should limit their operational capacity while hopefully preserving life. 

I like to think that today's outlaws are tomorrow's productive members of society.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Take Outlaws at ~mission(Location) Offline
routes.description:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity. 

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion. 

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
routes.description:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at ~mission(Location|Address) our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation. 

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Assistance Needed Against XenoThreat Raid
routes.description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at ~mission(Location|Address) first before heading to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Easy Cargo Recovery
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>

Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Package Recovery
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A contractor of ours has run into some trouble and abandoned their ship over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We need someone to head to their ship, pick up the package they left there, and finish the job.

PACKAGES TO RECOVER
     · <EM4>1x ~mission(Item1)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Deliver to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>

We’re currently uncertain as to why they failed to complete the contract, so be cautious when approaching the ship.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Interstellar Hauling
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
~mission(SingleToMultiToken)  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: Med. Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
routes.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>~mission(System) </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

~mission(Hint_Location) For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>~mission(Hint_Tool)</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

routes.mission_name: Northrock Service Group: Orison Platforms Under Attack
routes.description:
Greetings,

Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.

The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.

For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge. 

Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.

Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

routes.mission_name: Northrock Service Group: Retake Platforms From Nine Tails
routes.description:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to <EM4>disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters</EM4> that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

routes.mission_name: Wikelo Emporium: Heavy and Bright
routes.description: This armor is big, yes! Protect you real good. Wikelo make it extra bright so everyone can see how good your armor is. If you bring the things I need, I trade for it.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: High-Risk Bounty: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Intercepted Supply Run
routes.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Recovering Valuable Supplies
routes.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
routes.description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination)</EM4>  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
routes.description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Special Recovery Operation
routes.description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Intercepted Supply Run
routes.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: @Headhunters_EliminateAllFF_Title_001
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: A Swift Reprisal
routes.description:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in ~mission(Location|Address). Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Deal with Kopions at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Headhunters need someone to take out a pack of kopions that've been giving our guys a hard time. Last saw the things at ~mission(Location|Address). There's some creds in it for you if you finish the job.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Don't let Windfall Fall
routes.description:
Need some triggers to get over to ~mission(Location|Address) and defend one of our places that's under attack. Not sure who's looking for an early death, but we can figure that out once they're cold and still.

Bring some people if you want just make sure we take it back.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Reputation Management
routes.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from ~mission(Location|Address). We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(Location) has been greenlit
routes.description:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit ~mission(Location|Address). It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(Location|Address) under attack
routes.description:
Some geniuses thought it would be a good idea to try and knock over ~mission(Location|Address), so we're putting together a response to put them in the ground and also show everyone else what happens if you touch Headhunter turf.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hitting a CFP site
routes.description:
Need someone to sweep ~mission(Location|Address). CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge. 

Need it done fast and clean. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a hitter
routes.description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near ~mission(Location|Address). I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(Location|Address) under attack
routes.description:
Some geniuses thought it would be a good idea to try and knock over ~mission(Location|Address), so we're putting together a response to put them in the ground and also show everyone else what happens if you touch Headhunter turf.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Block XenoThreat Expansion
routes.description:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm ~mission(Location|Address) next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it. 

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely. 

Think you can rise to the occasion?  

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Butcher Kopion Pack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Huge swarm of kopions ran down one of our Clips the other day. Never found the body. Word is they ate the poor bastard. 

We need someone to head to ~mission(Location|Address) and shoot every kopion they see. Don't stop ’til the assholes are all dead. 

Watch your back when you go in. If you can’t guess, these bastards are mean. If you get yourself killed, that's on you. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Death and cargo
routes.description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to ~mission(Location|Address) where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back. 

Once you got the cargo, take it over to ~mission(Destination|Address) and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Halt XenoThreat Expansion
routes.description:
Not sure how familiar you are with what’s going down in Pyro, but we’re currently in a hell of a turf war with XenoThreat. It’s been pretty brutal lately, and I just learned that XenoThreat are about to attack ~mission(Location|Address). Thing is that I can’t rally any Clips to get there in time to defend it, so I need you to do it for us. 

Grab your gear, get some friends, and get to the location as fast as you can. Xenos like to stagger the arrival of their troops, so don’t blow through all your ammo during the initial defense ‘cause there’s a good chance more are coming. 

Keep them from taking over the site and I’ll pay you for the trouble.

-Stows out

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Kopions at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Bunch of kopions set up shop in Headhunter territory. Mean ones. Having to fight off wild animals every few hours is making it tough to do business. 

If you get rid of them for us, you get paid. Do it however you want – as long as they end up dead. 

You can find them at ~mission(Location|Address).

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Take back Carvers Ridge
routes.description:
I swear all the local scumbags have gotten a lot bolder since Citizens for Prosperity moved into here. Now we got a group attacking ~mission(Location|Address), so I need someone to take it back and remind them that Headhunters are still the power in the system.

If you take them out, I don't have to figure out who they are, so get to it.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: The Yard's under attack
routes.description:
Putting the word out. We got a Headhunter outpost near ~mission(Location|Address) under attack and could use some backup. Haven't quite figured out who's doing the attacking but don't really care. You step to the Headhunters, get ready to get clapped back.

Get over there pronto and take them down.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Turf War
routes.description:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over ~mission(Location|Address). We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wipe ~mission(Location) out
routes.description:
Caught wind that a crew of hardcore shipjackers are holed up around ~mission(Location|Address). They swiped a couple of Headhunter ships a few months ago after dumping the crew out the airlock, so we've been keeping an eye out for them ever since.

Want you to go there and show them the same kinda mercy they showed our people. Clear?

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: A little retaliation
routes.description:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to ~mission(Location|Address) and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit XenoThreat at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near ~mission(Location|Address). Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Rally at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Call's out for anybody itching to cause some violence. Some stupid skags thought they could knock over ~mission(Location|Address) and we wouldn't kick back. Go show them how wrong their thinking was.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
routes.description:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near ~mission(Location|Address).

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: A tricky tricky task
routes.description:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent ~mission(TargetName) undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, ~mission(TargetName|First) was heading to ~mission(Location|Address) to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid ~mission(TargetName|Last) might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to ~mission(TargetName|Last) and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if ~mission(TargetName|Last) is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at ~mission(Destination|Address) and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Driving CFP out
routes.description:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole ~mission(TargetName) opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit ~mission(Location|Address) and take out ~mission(TargetName|Last). Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
routes.description:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near ~mission(Location|Address) that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is ~mission(TargetName). Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Taking XenoThreat Turf
routes.description:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around ~mission(Location|Address). I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts. 

We've also gotten word that ~mission(TargetName) is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up. 

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Complex
routes.description:
Got a big one here. We need a team to head out to ~mission(Location|Address). Word is CFP are dug in at three different clusters in the area. Our judge wants them all cleared out. Seems one of their mercs, a real mean skag named ~mission(TargetName), is holed up at one of them. We want you to go there, clear them all out and take out ~mission(TargetName|Last).

Get yourself a nice little payday in the process.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
routes.description:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at ~mission(Location|Address) we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named ~mission(TargetName). Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of ~mission(TargetName|Last) or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and ~mission(TargetName|Last) won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit on XenoThreat command
routes.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at ~mission(Location|Address) to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: @Headhunters_EliminateAllFF_Title_001
