routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Launch Surprise Attack
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Need someone to take out a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and deal with the escort ships protecting it. They’ve already interfered with several of our ongoing operations and have become a real problem across several of Eckhart Security cases. Not sure what their endgame is, but it won’t matter once you deal with them.

We’ve let slip that we will be working a job over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> which should serve as bait to draw them out. The spot is ideal for an ambush because of the <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that’s a perfect place to power down and hide until you’re ready to strike. If you’re available, the <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and its escorts should be passing through soon.   

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The main contractor will also receive a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Tricky Ambush
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the ~mission(AmbushTarget) is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft. 

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.  

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Dangerous Ambush
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>, who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.  
  
Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Highly Dangerous Ambush
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Recently, we sent a contractor after a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>, who was leading a crew targeting the operations of an extremely important client. Unfortunately, it was a trap and we lost some good people. We can’t let the target get away again, so we’ve decided the best course of action is to give them a dose of their own medicine.  

Ambushing this target seems like the safest course of action, and we’ve identified a good spot for such an attack. There’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that the target and their crew frequently fly by. You can power down your ship and hide there until you’re ready to strike. This crew is ruthless and extremely skilled. Don’t make the same mistake as the previous contractor and go this alone. It would be best for you to bring a few trusted friends to help handle this crew.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. Plus, we’ll throw in a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor for taking care of this.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Emergency: Blinding Hope in Trouble
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blinding Hope in trouble

WORK BRIEF: 
We received a distress call from the Blinding Hope that said they were under attack from the Moraine again before they were cut off. I just want to know if they're okay. <EM4>Head to their last known location and report what you find</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Return of XenoThreat — 60,000 pts
routes.description:
The terrorist group XenoThreat have returned to Stanton seeking to violently impose their intolerant values on the system. Their well-armed members are harassing not only the alien residents, but anyone they have deemed a traitor to Humanity, specifically Human pilots of alien-made spacecraft.

It is clear that they will not stop attempting to spread their hatred unless we stop them.

Join us. Do your part.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Deep space hit
routes.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named ~mission(TargetName) and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find ~mission(TargetName|Last) around ~mission(Location|Address). Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill the king
routes.description:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at ~mission(Location|Address), they're getting hit by some geniuses led by ~mission(TargetName). We've tussled against ~mission(TargetName|Last) in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up. 

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) should be your focus.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Plug a traitor
routes.description:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with ~mission(TargetName) in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to ~mission(Location|Address), find ~mission(TargetName|Last), and kill them.

Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.

Damn shame.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a CFP taken down
routes.description:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName). Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty. 

Heard they're posted over at ~mission(Location|Address). Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Drop a XenoThreat
routes.description:
Got a line on a XenoThreat that's been a pain in the ass. Not sure if you've heard the name, but ~mission(TargetName) is a scumbag even by XenoThreat standards. Vicious, sadistic, and a prick to boot. We want someone to punch their number. You up for it?

Last word was that they were somewhere around ~mission(Location|Address). Head there and take 'em out. Pretty simple.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Paid Target in CFP
routes.description:
Headhunters are launching an attack near ~mission(Location|Address). This ex-Marine asshole named ~mission(TargetName) has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, ~mission(TargetName|Last) has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, ~mission(TargetName|Last) may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

Stows out.

Take 'em out.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Deal with ~mission(TargetName) and Support Forces
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> and their crew were identified executing a raid on <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. If their MO holds true, <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again. 

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Easy Cargo Recovery
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>

Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Package Recovery
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A contractor of ours has run into some trouble and abandoned their ship over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We need someone to head to their ship, pick up the package they left there, and finish the job.

PACKAGES TO RECOVER
     · <EM4>1x ~mission(Item1)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Deliver to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>

We’re currently uncertain as to why they failed to complete the contract, so be cautious when approaching the ship.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Interstellar Hauling
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------   

One of the folks over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> just hit me up about a pile of cargo, <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4> or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.   

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)  
~mission(SingleToMultiToken)  

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to bring along.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a death at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Need someone taken care of. They're holed up near ~mission(Location|Address). Not sure if you care who they are, but their name's ~mission(TargetName). Not much to tell, local thug who killed someone who was connected.

They've been on the run, so they're gonna be skittish. I'd approach with caution.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Reputation Management
routes.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from ~mission(Location|Address). We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Green light on ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to ~mission(Location|Address) and take it back.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Looking for a little revenge
routes.description:
Here's the deal. Some of those mercs that CFP hired as security went and shot up some Headhunters that were just moving through the system. They weren't even doing anything, just flying.

Anyway, we tracked them back to ~mission(Location|Address) and want to dish out some payback. Grab your gear and be our weapon, we'll make it worth your while.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a hitter
routes.description:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near ~mission(Location|Address). I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Back up needed at outpost
routes.description:
Those XenoThreat punks launched an attack against ~mission(Location|Address) so we're looking for people to go fend them off. 

Get out there and waste every XenoThreat you see.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Death and cargo
routes.description:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to ~mission(Location|Address) where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back. 

Once you got the cargo, take it over to ~mission(Destination|Address) and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Reputation Management
routes.description:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from ~mission(Location|Address). We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: A tricky tricky task
routes.description:
One of the local Judges has been trying to get info on some of new gangs in the area. You know, see if anyone's got eyes on what we got. That kinda thing. Anyway, we sent ~mission(TargetName) undercover to try and suss out if anyone's getting bright ideas to try and make a move.

Anyway, ~mission(TargetName|First) was heading to ~mission(Location|Address) to make a deal with some local grunts or whatever but we haven't heard back. Judge is afraid ~mission(TargetName|Last) might've been sniffed then snuffed, so we want you to head there and see what's what.

Go find what happened to ~mission(TargetName|Last) and get our cargo back. Odds are you'll need to shwack anyone you come across because if ~mission(TargetName|Last) is dead, these assholes killed a Headhunter.

Once you get the cargo, drop it off at ~mission(Destination|Address) and get a nice little payday.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Time to roll on CFP
routes.description:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at  ~mission(Location|Address) and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Go on the warpath
routes.description:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near ~mission(Location|Address). Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit on XenoThreat command
routes.description:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at ~mission(Location|Address) to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Hockrow Agency: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
routes.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Tricky Ambush
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the ~mission(AmbushTarget) is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft. 

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.  

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.

routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

You can power down your ship and hide there until you’re ready to strike. This crew is ruthless and extremely skilled. Don’t make the same mistake as the previous contractor and go this alone. It would be best for you to bring a few trusted friends to help handle this crew.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. Plus, we’ll throw in a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor for taking care of this.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: InterSec Defense Solutions: Assist People's Alliance Vessel Tranquility
routes.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat Ready
Briefing: 
An Idris-class People's Alliance security vessel named Tranquility is currently engaged with a <EM>Vanduul capital ship</EM4> near an old <EM4>QV Extraction station</EM4> and Intersec is looking for combat pilots to lend some support.

Scramble to the AO and <EM4>engage Vanduul fighters so the Tranquility can focus on the capital ship</EM4>. 

Good luck,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

routes.mission_name: Vaughn: They Will Be Missed
routes.description:
A senior security official by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at ~mission(Location|Address), they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

routes.mission_name: Vaughn: All Things Come To An End
routes.description:
I am not sure if you’re acquainted with ~mission(Location|Address), but ~mission(TargetName) is the one who calls the shots there. I need them eliminated.

That is easier said then done, I'm afraid. They are notoriously reluctant to see to matters personally, preferring their underlings to handle the dirty work. That said, eliminate enough of the underlings and they will have no choice but to deal with you themselves.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Return of XenoThreat — 102,000 pts
routes.description:
The terrorist group XenoThreat have returned to Stanton seeking to violently impose their intolerant values on the system. Their well-armed members are harassing not only the alien residents, but anyone they have deemed a traitor to Humanity, specifically Human pilots of alien-made spacecraft.

It is clear that they will not stop attempting to spread their hatred unless we stop them.

Join us. Do your part.

routes.mission_name: Hockrow Agency: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Power Usage Data
routes.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
It would be helpful to have the most recent energy anomaly data so that we can compare it to what you delivered last time. Any difference between the two data sets could prove useful.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Engineering</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Energy Anomaly data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

routes.mission_name: Hockrow Agency: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
routes.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Clear Outlaw Data Center
routes.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:

routes.mission_name: Hockrow Agency: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
routes.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

An Idris-class People's Alliance security vessel named Tranquility is currently engaged with a <EM>Vanduul capital ship</EM4> near an old <EM4>QV Extraction station</EM4> and Intersec is looking for combat pilots to lend some support.

Scramble to the AO and <EM4>engage Vanduul fighters so the Tranquility can focus on the capital ship</EM4>. 

Good luck,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: XL Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
routes.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>~mission(System) </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

~mission(Hint_Location) Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Reminder, all the <EM4>materials must be refined before delivery</EM4>, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>~mission(Hint_Tool)</EM4>.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Intercepted Supply Run
routes.description:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and bring a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Recovering Valuable Supplies
routes.description:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.

We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the supplies onto your ship.

Take them to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.

Be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
routes.description:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination)</EM4>  and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
routes.description:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Special Recovery Operation
routes.description:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to  <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> in order to  take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> and a <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4>.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Clear Outlaw Data Center
routes.description:
After several attempts at convincing the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) to stop their assaults on Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we have decided on a new course of action.

We want you to wipe out all the records they are storing on their servers. This setback should force them to reconsider their actions, or at the very least, give us time to assess further options.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.description:
There is a band of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) who have increasingly become an issue for Citizens for Prosperity settlements in the sector.

While direct violence against the perpetrators would potentially be effective, it is not in the spirit of our mission here. Instead, we would like you to take the generators near their stronghold offline. This should limit their operational capacity while hopefully preserving life.

Lima Endicott

routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

Lima Endicott

routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Assistance Needed Against XenoThreat Raid
routes.description:
The XenoThreat have mercilessly attacked our people and they are now in desperate need of combat support and medical supplies.

If you're available, you'll need to pick up the supplies at ~mission(Location|Address) first before heading to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>. Once on site, it is important that you neutralize all the hostiles before completing delivery of the supplies.

Additionally, to help prevent an incident like this happening again, we believe that having you destroy the XenoThreat servers at <EM4>~mission(Location1|Address)</EM4> would act as a further deterrent.

Citizens for Prosperity
