routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Launch Surprise Attack
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Need someone to take out a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and deal with the escort ships protecting it. They’ve already interfered with several of our ongoing operations and have become a real problem across several of Eckhart Security cases. Not sure what their endgame is, but it won’t matter once you deal with them.

We’ve let slip that we will be working a job over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> which should serve as bait to draw them out. The spot is ideal for an ambush because of the <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that’s a perfect place to power down and hide until you’re ready to strike. If you’re available, the <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> and its escorts should be passing through soon.   

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The main contractor will also receive a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4>.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Tricky Ambush
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4> which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the ~mission(AmbushTarget) is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft. 

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.  

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Dangerous Ambush
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>, who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.  
  
Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Highly Dangerous Ambush
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Recently, we sent a contractor after a <EM4>~mission(AmbushTarget)</EM4>, who was leading a crew targeting the operations of an extremely important client. Unfortunately, it was a trap and we lost some good people. We can’t let the target get away again, so we’ve decided the best course of action is to give them a dose of their own medicine.  

Ambushing this target seems like the safest course of action, and we’ve identified a good spot for such an attack. There’s an <EM4>emission cloud</EM4> near <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that the target and their crew frequently fly by. You can power down your ship and hide there until you’re ready to strike. This crew is ruthless and extremely skilled. Don’t make the same mistake as the previous contractor and go this alone. It would be best for you to bring a few trusted friends to help handle this crew.    

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. Plus, we’ll throw in a bonus payment of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor for taking care of this.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Hockrow Agency: Jorrit Dossier: Updated Security Data
routes.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
Out of an over-abundance of caution, it would be good to see if the security systems have picked up anything new since the last batch of data you delivered. That way we can make sure we’re up-to-date on what’s been happening down there.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the <EM4>Research</EM4> wing and <EM4>retrieve the Security data</EM4> and deliver it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site. 

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a <EM4>ASD Secure Drive</EM4> that you can collect at your home location.

routes.mission_name: Hockrow Agency: Jorrit Dossier: Project Hyperion
routes.description:
Hockrow Agency 
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update: 
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his <EM4>lab notes to your mobiGlas journal</EM4> once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.

The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running. 

Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a <EM4>Reagent code from the Engineering wing</EM4> and a <EM4>Catalyst code from the Research wing</EM4>.

Once you have those, head down to the <EM4>Lab in Site-B</EM4> and <EM4>run the experiment</EM4> so you can <EM4>upload the results</EM4>.

Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
 
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

For any pilots in the area – a group of bandits is targeting one of our clients at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, specifically their <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and the maintenance ships that manage them. From our intel, it's only a few outlaws trying to make some quick credits, but they're also the type to cause some real damage if you get in their way.

If you take care of them and relocate the client's ship and crew safely, we’re offering <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Easy Cargo Recovery
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>

Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A contractor of ours has run into some trouble and abandoned their ship over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We need someone to head to their ship, pick up the package they left there, and finish the job.

PACKAGES TO RECOVER
     · <EM4>1x ~mission(Item1)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Deliver to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>

We’re currently uncertain as to why they failed to complete the contract, so be cautious when approaching the ship.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Ling Family Hauling: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
routes.description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:  

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(MultiToSingleToken)     

Please remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4>, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>.  

  
Happy Hauling,  
Reyes Ling 
Cargo Logistics Coordinator 
Ling Family Hauling

routes.mission_name: Northrock Service Group: Orison Platforms Under Attack
routes.description:
Greetings,

Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.

The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.

For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge. 

Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.

Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

routes.mission_name: Northrock Service Group: Retake Platforms From Nine Tails
routes.description:
Glad to have you undertaking this operation for Northrock. Here is the full brief:

Your priority is to <EM4>disable all three Identify Friend or Foe Inverters</EM4> that are blocking Crusader Security from accessing the airspace around these platforms. Once the inverters are offline, Crusader Security will be able to fly their ships in and resecure the platforms. In the meanwhile, the platforms are connected by a series of shuttles unaffected by the inverters and will serve as your main form of transport between them.

Be aware that you will meet heavy resistance as you progress. Crusader has tried multiple times to deal with this incursion themselves but have thus far been unsuccessful. However, we believe a small strike team will prove more effective in dealing with the Nine Tails forces. 

Additionally, in the spirit of full cooperation, Crusader has given you carte blanche to utilize any of the resources you discover that may prove helpful to the mission. 

Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
routes.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> looking to be topped up with ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

routes.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: Med. Purchase Order: Ship Mined Ore
routes.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>~mission(System) </EM4>

TERMS*: 
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

~mission(Hint_Location) For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a <EM4>~mission(Hint_Tool)</EM4>.

Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, <EM4>they must be refined before delivery</EM4>. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a tip about <EM4>a ship that had been attacked at ~mission(Location)</EM4>.  Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there. 

We're looking for someone to go out, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and bring it to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> so we can figure out what happened. 

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF: 
There's been another attack out at ~mission(Location). Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and deliver it ~mission(Destination)</EM4>. Make sure you <EM4>bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox</EM4>.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet <EM4>they're still in the area</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger

WORK BRIEF: 
We had another ship attacked out near ~mission(Location) and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and <EM4>retrieve the blackbox</EM4>. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage.</EM4>

Just be careful, there's a real good chance <EM4>the ambushers are still there waiting</EM4> for someone to claim it.

If you're able to get it, <EM4>deliver the blackbox to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Efficient Miners Wanted
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Efficient Miners Wanted

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with something. If you could harvest ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4>, that would really help out our understanding of the current mineral levels in the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: High Priority Ore Scan
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Priority Ore Scan

WORK BRIEF: 
I'm looking for people to go out and find deposits of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4> to contribute to a system-wide experiment that will help plan future mining operations. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Hope I can rely on you.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with a prospecting job. Need someone to track down a deposit of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4>. 
This data will be helpful for some studies we're doing about mineral levels. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Mining and Data Collection
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining and Data Collection

WORK BRIEF: 
Have a big one for you today. Need you to get down there and mine ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4> and relay your stats back to us. I'm looking to pull together some findings from various miners around the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Missing Persons
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Persons

WORK BRIEF: 
A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.

I'll send you <EM4>their last known location</EM4>. Just head out there and see what happened.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Moraine Movements
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Movements

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but <EM4>it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there</EM4>, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

WORK BRIEF: 
Word got passed over that <EM4>there's a large derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>, so we're putting the word out for anyone who's got the ships and gear to break it down. 

If you can chop it up, then <EM4>deliver the resources to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll pay you for your time.

Battaglia, Recco

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a call about <EM4>a derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>. Ran the regtag through the system to make sure we weren't taking someone's ride but it looks unclaimed, so I need someone with a salvage ship to head out and break it down.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: VIP Client Needs Protection
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In need of a contractor who can report in now. A client has found themselves in hot water over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and a protection detail to get away from an asteroid base. They’ve reported multiple, well-armed hostile ships meaning you’ll need a crew of your own to deal with them. Based on the client’s account, these attackers seem highly motivated so they will likely not back down easily.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Protection Detail Needed. High Risk.
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

I’m in need of a highly competent pilot who can gather a crew of equally capable pilots for an escort mission. The mining base at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is currently under attack from a group of outlaws and the crew there is unable to leave without assistance. Our scouts have reported that the attackers are armed with exceptional weaponry and ships.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Top Tier Operator Needed
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

This contract should only be considered by the most capable of pilots. A highly valued client is currently under attack at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and requires immediate extraction. They’re sitting in the hangar ready to leave, but are unable to move until the hostile ships in the area have been neutralized. 

I don’t see the outlaws stopping any time soon and our client’s reporting they’re packing high-grade weaponry on their ships. This will be a test of your skill as much as your endurance. Assemble whoever you need and head there immediately to assist them.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a tip about <EM4>a ship that had been attacked at ~mission(Location)</EM4>.  Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there. 

We're looking for someone to go out, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and bring it to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> so we can figure out what happened. 

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF: 
There's been another attack out at ~mission(Location). Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and deliver it ~mission(Destination)</EM4>. Make sure you <EM4>bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox</EM4>.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet <EM4>they're still in the area</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger

WORK BRIEF: 
We had another ship attacked out near ~mission(Location) and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and <EM4>retrieve the blackbox</EM4>. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage.</EM4>

Just be careful, there's a real good chance <EM4>the ambushers are still there waiting</EM4> for someone to claim it.

If you're able to get it, <EM4>deliver the blackbox to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Efficient Miners Wanted
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Efficient Miners Wanted

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with something. If you could harvest ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4>, that would really help out our understanding of the current mineral levels in the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: High Priority Ore Scan
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Priority Ore Scan

WORK BRIEF: 
I'm looking for people to go out and find deposits of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4> to contribute to a system-wide experiment that will help plan future mining operations. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Hope I can rely on you.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with a prospecting job. Need someone to track down a deposit of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4>. 
This data will be helpful for some studies we're doing about mineral levels. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Mining and Data Collection
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining and Data Collection

WORK BRIEF: 
Have a big one for you today. Need you to get down there and mine ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4> and relay your stats back to us. I'm looking to pull together some findings from various miners around the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Missing Persons
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Persons

WORK BRIEF: 
A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.

I'll send you <EM4>their last known location</EM4>. Just head out there and see what happened.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Moraine Movements
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Movements

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but <EM4>it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there</EM4>, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Large
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Large Ship Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Word got passed over that <EM4>there's a large derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>, so we're putting the word out for anyone who's got the ships and gear to break it down. 

If you can chop it up, then <EM4>deliver the resources to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll pay you for your time.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Mid
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Medium Ship Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got word that a ship got destroyed out by ~mission(Location) after an ambush. Owner is willing to pay for someone to go salvage the parts and <EM4>bring them to ~mission(Destination)</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Small
routes.description:

******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a call about <EM4>a derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>. Ran the regtag through the system to make sure we weren't taking someone's ride but it looks unclaimed, so I need someone with a salvage ship to head out and break it down. 

Once you're done, <EM4>take the resources to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a tip about <EM4>a ship that had been attacked at ~mission(Location)</EM4>.  Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there. 

We're looking for someone to go out, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and bring it to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> so we can figure out what happened. 

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF: 
There's been another attack out at ~mission(Location). Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and deliver it ~mission(Destination)</EM4>. Make sure you <EM4>bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox</EM4>.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet <EM4>they're still in the area</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.description:

Eugene Walton

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: InterSec Defense Solutions: Tactical Strike Group Needed
routes.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing: 
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across  Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site. 

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will <EM4>need  ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station</EM4> and ultimately <EM4>get boots on the ground to save their pilot</EM4>.

<EM4>Recruiting additional ships</EM4> to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will <EM4>need a variety of ship types</EM4> to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Although the group seems to be unaffiliated with any of the known gangs, we've received word that their leader is ~mission(TargetName), a local outlaw with a vicious reputation.

Please head out as soon as you can and secure the area by taking out the outlaws and ~mission(TargetName|Last).

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that ~mission(TargetName|Last) tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.

XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

We're looking to take these clusters back so we can reestablish operations and continue our good work. You'll need to clear all the hostiles still on-site as well as ~mission(TargetName|Last).

Just a reminder, that XenoThreat are highly trained and quick to fight, so prepare accordingly.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Defend ~mission(Location) from Outlaws
routes.description:
We learned that ~mission(Location|Address) is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws. 

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Help defend ~mission(Location) from Headhunters
routes.description:
We just received a frantic comm from ~mission(Location|Address) and are looking for any available combat specialists to help repel a Headhunter attack. There are still hostiles on site and there are reports of several casualties so we need this handled quickly.

I will provide all relevant data upon acceptance. Thank you for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Protect ~mission(Location) from XenoThreat Attack
routes.description:
We’ve learned that XenoThreat is about to launch an attack on ~mission(Location|Address). If they are successful, the number of casualties is expected to be high. I’m hoping that with your aid in defending them, we can make sure that doesn’t happen.
 
We know from past encounters that XenoThreat sends several raiding parties to carry out their attacks, so make sure you don’t leave the outpost until you’ve fought off all the reinforcements. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Need multiple CFP outposts retaken
routes.description:
The outlaw presence here has become much bolder of late and a lot of people are getting hurt. We've recently lost several clusters around ~mission(Location|Address). While we don't like to have to resort to violence, the board has acknowledged that these locations are crucial to establishing stability in the system and authorized the use of a security detail to retake them.

We're also aware that the embedded hostiles are being led by ~mission(TargetName) who's had a history of attacking CFP interests. The board would like ~mission(TargetName|Last) dealt with to prevent future attacks.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reclaiming Clusters from Headhunters
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near ~mission(Location|Address) that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out ~mission(TargetName), who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Campaign to reclaim XenoThreat outposts
routes.description:
Although Citizens for Prosperity is committed to change through non-violent means, it's become apparent that exceptions might have to be made. CFP safe zones near ~mission(Location|Address) were recently and violently taken by XenoThreat forces under the command of ~mission(TargetName).

We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.

Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out ~mission(TargetName|Last), who's loss will certainly make the system safer.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reclaim Headhunter Outpost
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for security personnel to take a former CFP outpost that's currently serving as a hideout for Headhunters to launch attacks throughout the system. 

Located near ~mission(Location|Address), reclaiming this outpost will allow CFP to provide greater support to local efforts to build stability.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Defenders needed against Headhunters
routes.description:
We received an emergency comm from ~mission(Location|Address) reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Attack on CFP outpost
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available combat operators to ~mission(Location|Address). A group of outlaws have launched an unprovoked attack and our security personnel are desperately in need of support.

Please dispatch to ~mission(Location) with all urgency and good luck.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Call for Help: ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
We've received a distress call from ~mission(Location|Address). A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reclaim XenoThreat Outpost
routes.description:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted ~mission(Location|Address) and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.

We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: ~mission(Location|Address) needs help
routes.description:
We just received reports of a massive attack against ~mission(Location) by a large group of armed individuals led by ~mission(TargetName), a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Protect ~mission(Location) from XenoThreat Raid
routes.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is targeting ~mission(Location|Address) to send a message to other settlers about what happens if they accept our support. 

If you’re able to fend off the attackers, I’m sure they’ll send additional forces, so you’ll need to dig in for multiple assaults. Since XenoThreat has a lot of resources at their disposal, you should think about recruiting others to help you keep everyone safe.

We’re all counting on you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Protect ~mission(Location) from XenoThreat Incursion
routes.description:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe ~mission(Location|Address) off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott

routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Wikelo Emporium: Your Best Shot
routes.description: This rifle is very good at shooting, but could have nicer design. Wikelo fix. Looks very nice now. Give to you for trade. Bring me things, I give you rifle. Even give you blueprint if you need.

routes.mission_name: Vaughn: A Challenging Contract
routes.description:
I've been conscripted to provide a trigger pull for a very motivated client. The target is <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4>, a loathsome character by all accounts who's seemed to relish the temporary authority that their mercenary position affords them. They believe their sadism to be righteous and my client would like to remind them otherwise.

They have recently been hired by ASD as part of a mercenary team at <EM4>~mission(Location)</EM4>, so it won't be an easy approach as there will undoubtedly be other armed individuals. I'll expect you to react accordingly, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) is your target.

You will be paid upon completion.

All the best,

Vaughn

routes.mission_name: Vaughn: All Things Come To An End
routes.description:
They say there is no honor among thieves. Today, it seems, you're targeting one of your own. 

Please head to ~mission(Location|Address) and kill ~mission(TargetName). What you do with the others there is entirely up to you.

Earnestly,
Vaughn
