routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
Received a tip about <EM4>a ship that had been attacked at ~mission(Location)</EM4>.  Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there. 

We're looking for someone to go out, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and bring it to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> so we can figure out what happened. 

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF: 
There's been another attack out at ~mission(Location). Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, <EM4>retrieve the blackbox and deliver it ~mission(Destination)</EM4>. Make sure you <EM4>bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox</EM4>.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd bet <EM4>they're still in the area</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger

WORK BRIEF: 
We had another ship attacked out near ~mission(Location) and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and <EM4>retrieve the blackbox</EM4>. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but <EM4>you'll need a ship with some storage.</EM4>

Just be careful, there's a real good chance <EM4>the ambushers are still there waiting</EM4> for someone to claim it.

If you're able to get it, <EM4>deliver the blackbox to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Efficient Miners Wanted
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Efficient Miners Wanted

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with something. If you could harvest ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4>, that would really help out our understanding of the current mineral levels in the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: High Priority Ore Scan
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Priority Ore Scan

WORK BRIEF: 
I'm looking for people to go out and find deposits of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4> to contribute to a system-wide experiment that will help plan future mining operations. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Hope I can rely on you.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm

WORK BRIEF: 
Need your help with a prospecting job. Need someone to track down a deposit of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4>. 
This data will be helpful for some studies we're doing about mineral levels. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Thanks in advance.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Mining and Data Collection
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining and Data Collection

WORK BRIEF: 
Have a big one for you today. Need you to get down there and mine ~mission(Resources) ~mission(MineableType)</EM4> and relay your stats back to us. I'm looking to pull together some findings from various miners around the system. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, <EM4>the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.</EM4>

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Missing Persons
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Persons

WORK BRIEF: 
A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.

I'll send you <EM4>their last known location</EM4>. Just head out there and see what happened.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Moraine Movements
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Movements

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but <EM4>it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there</EM4>, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Large
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Large Ship Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Word got passed over that <EM4>there's a large derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>, so we're putting the word out for anyone who's got the ships and gear to break it down. 

If you can chop it up, then <EM4>deliver the resources to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll pay you for your time.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Mid
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Medium Ship Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got word that a ship got destroyed out by ~mission(Location) after an ambush. Owner is willing to pay for someone to go salvage the parts and <EM4>bring them to ~mission(Destination)</EM4>.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Salvage Job: Small
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Salvage

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a call about <EM4>a derelict ship out near ~mission(Location)</EM4>. Ran the regtag through the system to make sure we weren't taking someone's ride but it looks unclaimed, so I need someone with a salvage ship to head out and break it down. 

Once you're done, <EM4>take the resources to ~mission(Destination)</EM4> and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon resource delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Defend ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description:
For any pilots in the area – a group of bandits is targeting one of our clients at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, specifically their <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and the maintenance ships that manage them. From our intel, it's only a few outlaws trying to make some quick credits, but they're also the type to cause some real damage if you get in their way.

If you take care of them and relocate the client's ship and crew safely, we’re offering <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description:
We need a contractor to provide convoy and protection services at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. One of our elite clients' are under attack from a band of outlaws targeting their <EM4>~mission(Objects) and ships</EM4>. You'll need to keep the crew safe as they traverse the area, as well as make sure the assets stay as intact. These thugs look like they can do some real damage, so be sure you engage them with caution or the client might not be the only one to take heavy losses.

If you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> as compensation to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
routes.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> is in need of ~mission(FuelType), so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
routes.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting ~mission(FuelType). Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: URGENT REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
routes.description:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use ~mission(FuelType). If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there. 

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Crew Hasn’t Checked In
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In

WORK BRIEF: 
Just got word that one of the mining teams is unaccounted for. They were supposed to be back hours ago, but no one’s heard from them. Family have tried to reach out but haven’t gotten a response from anyone on the crew.

I can send you their last known location, so we’re looking for someone to go check in and see if they’re okay. If the worst happened, <EM4>please identify anyone you find</EM4>. I’m sure the families would appreciate some closure on what happened.

Thanks

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Full Area Scan for Ore
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Full Area Scan For Ore

WORK BRIEF: 
I need you to check something out for me if you’re not busy. I'm looking to build on our mineral database and need some scans of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4>. I can handle the mining if you want to leave it. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Let me know.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Missing Mining Team
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Mining Team

WORK BRIEF: 
One of our local crews set off for a dig and haven’t checked back in. With everything going on out there, people are starting to get a little worried, so <EM4>we’d like someone to try and get eyes on them</EM4>.

I hate to say this, but if something happened to them, could you <EM4>please identify everyone you find</EM4> so we can let next of kin know?

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Moraine Data Retrieval
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Data Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
routes.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> looking to be topped up with ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleIntro)
routes.description:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.

If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?

Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> that we want.

All you have to do is take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleVeryEasy)
routes.description:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>.

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleEasy)
routes.description:
So we were expecting a pretty important package earlier today but turns out the pilot got ghosted and they ripped the tracking chip from it and got away. Pretty clever right? Not really, because they forgot to take the flight recorder too.

Get the blackbox from the wreck at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>. We’ll send you the creds when you’re done.

Oh and watch out for scavs, people are pretty desperate these days, even if it just some busted courier ship.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|RecoverItemTitle)
routes.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleMedium)
routes.description:
We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.

The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?

Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleHard)
routes.description:
Don’t know if you’ve heard, but there’s a bunch of ships over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> surrounding a burnt-out ship. You curious why? I know we are.
Think you can get in that wreck, grab the blackbox, and get out? We’ll pay you for it.

Based on the number of sketchy ships in the area, you should bring some friends with to watch your ass, unless you’re some crazy solo act, but we’d prefer if you actually survived this so you can drop off the blackbox at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> for us. 

But hey, your call. As long as it gets done.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleVeryHard)
routes.description:
Someone of interest to us recently kicked the bucket (not our fault) over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and we’re pretty curious what happened. We need you to grab the blackbox from the ship and drop it off at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>.

This is a shipwreck by the way, so chances are some scavs will be around there too. But don’t worry, that’s been factored into your pay too.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|BlackBoxRecoverTitleSuper)
routes.description:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>, we can really make it worth your while.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Defend ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description:
For any pilots in the area – a group of bandits is targeting one of our clients at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, specifically their <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and the maintenance ships that manage them. From our intel, it's only a few outlaws trying to make some quick credits, but they're also the type to cause some real damage if you get in their way.

If you take care of them and relocate the client's ship and crew safely, we’re offering <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor. 

Good luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description:
We need a contractor to provide convoy and protection services at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: REFUEL REQUEST: ~mission(Ship)
routes.description:
Hey there,

If you're fitted for refueling, you might like this one. 

A beacon has just gone live at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>, from a client whose <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> is in need of ~mission(FuelType), so make sure your pods are topped off.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Looks like a zero-drama one and done, but it never hurts to keep your scanners live.
Let me know if you're interested and let's get these good people on their way.

Waiting to hear from you,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

routes.mission_name: United Wayfarers Club: URGENT CONVOY REFUEL
routes.description:
Hey again,

I've got a beacon at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting ~mission(FuelType). Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time. 

The client will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club

routes.description:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> looking to be topped up with ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say. 

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: High-Risk Bounty: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Shared)
routes.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

routes.mission_name: Highpoint Wilderness Specialists: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
routes.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Despite our warnings, a client decided to fly to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Unsurprisingly, they just dropped a rescue beacon in the area, so we’re looking for a contractor to get on site, assess the situation, and hopefully rescue the client.

We warned them that extremely dangerous and well-equipped outlaws often strike ships there. That’s exactly what I assume happened here, so make sure you plan accordingly.  

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: InterSec Defense Solutions: Eliminate Vanduul Ship
routes.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: InterSec requires the services of a skilled pilot who’s prepared to assist in taking down a dangerous Vanduul target that has been involved in numerous attacks.

Vanduul incursions have been on the rise recently, posing not only a threat to the system of Nyx, but the UEE as a whole. It is imperative that these sightings are responded to in a swift and efficient manner. 

We require you to fly to the last known sighting of the Vanduul ship at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and eliminate them immediately.  

Vanduul pilots are highly skilled and extremely dangerous. Engage the enemy immediately and do not hesitate – they will not show the same mercy.

Compensation proportionate to the risk of the contract will be awarded.


Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Come to Aid of Convoy
routes.description:
I’m getting reports that a Citizens for Prosperity convoy carrying vital supplies is currently under attack at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. It’d be a big blow to our operations if we lost that cargo. 

If you’ve got the combat skills to go up against highly aggressive hostiles, we’re more than willing to pay for your help. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Return of XenoThreat — 60,000 pts
routes.description:
The terrorist group XenoThreat have returned to Stanton seeking to violently impose their intolerant values on the system. Their well-armed members are harassing not only the alien residents, but anyone they have deemed a traitor to Humanity, specifically Human pilots of alien-made spacecraft.

It is clear that they will not stop attempting to spread their hatred unless we stop them.

Join us. Do your part.

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Pilot in Distress
routes.description:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at ~mission(Location|Address) and they won't make it much longer without support. 

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Highpoint Wilderness Specialists: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
routes.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott

routes.mission_name: Vaughn: End of a Salamander
routes.description:
One of the leaders of the mysterious Claw Salamanders gang, a ~mission(TargetName), has worn out their welcome and has now become our problem to deal with. It's hardly a surprise figuring no one except their friends could understand what they're saying. 

Unfortunately, it won't be as easy as heading to ~mission(Location|Address) and dealing with them directly. Not only will you have to ensure the station is operational to reach them, it seems that you will have to draw them out of hiding too by taking out a fair number of their compatriots first.

Not the simplest of jobs, but I'm sure you'll rise to the occasion.

All the best,
Vaughn

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Shared)
routes.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

routes.mission_name: Highpoint Wilderness Specialists: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
routes.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Shared)
routes.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser. 

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself. 

<EM4>TERMS*:</EM4>
We are making available the <EM4>shared mining rights</EM4> to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to you and your crew. (Remember, any other interested parties who purchase the mining rights will get access to the station as well.) Your crew will then be free to head there with a <EM4>mining vessel</EM4>, restore the <EM4>station's mining laser</EM4> to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and <EM4>harvest the resources</EM4> inside. 

Please note that since this is a shared contract we are able to offer these mining rights at a reduced prices, but the resources in the asteroid will be available on a <EM4>first come, first serve</EM4> basis with any other mining crews at the site. Also, there is also a chance that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised. 

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

routes.mission_name: Highpoint Wilderness Specialists: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
routes.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

The terrorist group XenoThreat have returned to Stanton seeking to violently impose their intolerant values on the system. Their well-armed members are harassing not only the alien residents, but anyone they have deemed a traitor to Humanity, specifically Human pilots of alien-made spacecraft.

routes.mission_name: Highpoint Wilderness Specialists: Reduce Valakkar Breaker Station Population
routes.description:
If you have any work that's going to be bringing you to one of those old QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, we have something else that we could use your help on while you're there.
 
We've recently been contacted by the People's Alliance to assist with an initiative to help prepare these abandoned stations for repairs. Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.
 
Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.
 
Best,
 
Wanda Werkheiser

Contract Manager

Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

routes.mission_name: Shubin Interstellar: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Shared)
routes.description:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS: 
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years. 

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Return of XenoThreat — 60,000 pts
routes.description:
The terrorist group XenoThreat have returned to Stanton seeking to violently impose their intolerant values on the system. Their well-armed members are harassing not only the alien residents, but anyone they have deemed a traitor to Humanity, specifically Human pilots of alien-made spacecraft.

It is clear that they will not stop attempting to spread their hatred unless we stop them.

Join us. Do your part.

routes.mission_name: Wikelo Emporium: Monolith Armor Very Smooth
routes.description:
When fight, you want armor that solid. Keep gun from helpful organ you need to live, yes, but should be impressive too. Wikelo make version of Monolith armor that do both.

You want? Bring me things I need for new project and I will give. Show you how to make too. More happy.

routes.mission_name: Bit Zeros: ~mission(Contractor|RecoverItemTitle)
routes.description:
Managed to hunt down a rare piece of tech only for it to get snagged by someone right at the last second. Tracking it isn't exactly hard, but I'd rather not keeping chasing this thing.

Head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and get it back for us. The people over there probably don't even know what it is, so let's do them a favor and take it off their hands. No idea if it's being guarded, so up to you how you wanna deal with any potential threats.

Once you've got it, take it to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4> and then we'll send over the creds.

-Bit Zeros

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Deep space hit
routes.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named ~mission(TargetName) and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find ~mission(TargetName|Last) around ~mission(Location|Address). Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill the king
routes.description:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at ~mission(Location|Address), they're getting hit by some geniuses led by ~mission(TargetName). We've tussled against ~mission(TargetName|Last) in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up. 

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) should be your focus.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need someone taken out
routes.description:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName). We've tracked them to  ~mission(Location|Address), so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you. 

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Head of the snake
routes.description:
Clashing with some XenoThreat scumbags over at ~mission(Location|Address) and learned that ~mission(TargetName) is leading them. I ran it by my Judge and she lit up at the chance to take this asshole down, so we want you to head out there and make sure they don't walk away from this attack.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a CFP taken down
routes.description:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName). Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty. 

Heard they're posted over at ~mission(Location|Address). Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a scalpel at Carver's
routes.description:
Got some people over at ~mission(Location|Address) weathering the storm of a XenoThreat assault. That sucks, sure, but turns out it's providing an opportunity for some payback. Those XenoThreat pukes are being led by ~mission(TargetName) who's been on the shit list of my boss for weeks now.

I'm looking for you to head out there and put 'em down.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Shot in the chaos
routes.description:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake ~mission(Location|Address). The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by ~mission(TargetName) and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit on XenoThreat at the Yard
routes.description:
Not sure if you've heard but ~mission(Location|Address) is getting hit by XenoThreat. Situation's not good, but under control. Here's the deal though, the assholes attacking are being led by some real trash named ~mission(TargetName). We've dealt with ~mission(TargetName|Last) before and they continually slip away before we can put them down.

That changes. We want you to head there and take out ~mission(TargetName|Last) before they squirm out of this noose.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: XenoThreat Lieutenant needs some killing
routes.description:
Headhunters just rallied up a crew to go hit ~mission(Location|Address) and wipe out the XenoThreat there, but I'm looking to add some extra insurance. 

See there's this heavy hitter there named ~mission(TargetName) who's up in the XenoThreat command structure and we want them taken out. Every other one you kill is gravy, but they're your prime target.

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a hit on the Riviera
routes.description:
So we got a situation over at ~mission(Location|Address). One of our outposts is getting hit by XenoThreat. While that kinda blows, it is giving us an interesting opportunity. See the attack's being led by ~mission(TargetName) who's been on the Headhunters shit list for some time now.

We want you to head there and take them out. Feel free to kill any other XenoThreat assholes you want, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) is the target. Lotta people have tried before so it definitely won't be easy. I'd even recommend bringing some friends, whatever it takes to finally put ~mission(TargetName|Last) down.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named ~mission(TargetName) just came out of hiding and was spotted at ~mission(Location|Address). 

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure ~mission(TargetName|Last) doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Green light on ~mission(TargetName|Last)
routes.description:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named ~mission(TargetName) who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at ~mission(Location|Address) who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. ~mission(TargetName|Last) is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out ~mission(TargetName|Last), they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to ~mission(Location|Address), find ~mission(TargetName|Last), and kill them.

Damn shame.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Drop a XenoThreat
routes.description:
Got a line on a XenoThreat that's been a pain in the ass. Not sure if you've heard the name, but ~mission(TargetName) is a scumbag even by XenoThreat standards. Vicious, sadistic, and a prick to boot. We want someone to punch their number. You up for it?

Last word was that they were somewhere around ~mission(Location|Address). Head there and take 'em out. Pretty simple.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Paid Target in CFP
routes.description:
Headhunters are launching an attack near ~mission(Location|Address). This ex-Marine asshole named ~mission(TargetName) has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, ~mission(TargetName|Last) has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, ~mission(TargetName|Last) may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows

Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named ~mission(TargetName) and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find ~mission(TargetName|Last) around ~mission(Location|Address). Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Head of the snake
routes.description:
Clashing with some XenoThreat scumbags over at ~mission(Location|Address) and learned that ~mission(TargetName) is leading them. I ran it by my Judge and she lit up at the chance to take this asshole down, so we want you to head out there and make sure they don't walk away from this attack.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill the king
routes.description:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at ~mission(Location|Address), they're getting hit by some geniuses led by ~mission(TargetName). We've tussled against ~mission(TargetName|Last) in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up. 

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) should be your focus.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a CFP taken down

Heard they're posted over at ~mission(Location|Address). Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a scalpel at Carver's
routes.description:

I'm looking for you to head out there and put 'em down.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Shot in the chaos
routes.description:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake ~mission(Location|Address). The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by ~mission(TargetName) and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit on XenoThreat at the Yard
routes.description:

Here's the deal though, the assholes attacking are being led by some real trash named ~mission(TargetName). We've dealt with ~mission(TargetName|Last) before and they continually slip away before we can put them down.

That changes. We want you to head there and take out ~mission(TargetName|Last) before they squirm out of this noose.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: XenoThreat Lieutenant needs some killing

Headhunters just rallied up a crew to go hit ~mission(Location|Address) and wipe out the XenoThreat there, but I'm looking to add some extra insurance.

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a hit on the Riviera
routes.description:

We want you to head there and take them out. Feel free to kill any other XenoThreat assholes you want, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) is the target. Lotta people have tried before so it definitely won't be easy. I'd even recommend bringing some friends, whatever it takes to finally put ~mission(TargetName|Last) down.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named ~mission(TargetName) just came out of hiding and was spotted at ~mission(Location|Address). 

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure ~mission(TargetName|Last) doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Green light on ~mission(TargetName|Last)
routes.description:

We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at ~mission(Location|Address) who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. ~mission(TargetName|Last) is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out ~mission(TargetName|Last), they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Return of XenoThreat — 120,000 pts
routes.description:
The terrorist group XenoThreat have returned to Stanton seeking to violently impose their intolerant values on the system. Their well-armed members are harassing not only the alien residents, but anyone they have deemed a traitor to Humanity, specifically Human pilots of alien-made spacecraft.

It is clear that they will not stop attempting to spread their hatred unless we stop them.

Join us. Do your part.

routes.mission_name: InterSec Defense Solutions: Tactical Strike Group Needed
routes.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing: 
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across  Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site. 

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will <EM4>need  ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station</EM4> and ultimately <EM4>get boots on the ground to save their pilot</EM4>.

<EM4>Recruiting additional ships</EM4> to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will <EM4>need a variety of ship types</EM4> to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions  

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.
