routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Deep space hit
routes.description:
Got word of crew that's been pulling jobs and building a rep for themselves. Since they've said they don't want anything to do with Headhunters, we're looking to break 'em apart before they become a problem. Their leader is some punk named ~mission(TargetName) and we figure if they met the wrong end of a bullet, the rest of them would break apart.

We're told you can find ~mission(TargetName|Last) around ~mission(Location|Address). Head over and take care of it.

They shouldn't pose much of a problem to a pro like you.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill the king
routes.description:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at ~mission(Location|Address), they're getting hit by some geniuses led by ~mission(TargetName). We've tussled against ~mission(TargetName|Last) in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up. 

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but ~mission(TargetName|Last) should be your focus.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need someone taken out
routes.description:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName). We've tracked them to  ~mission(Location|Address), so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you. 

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.

routes.description:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName). Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty. 

Heard they're posted over at ~mission(Location|Address). Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a scalpel at Carver's
routes.description:
Got some people over at ~mission(Location|Address) weathering the storm of a XenoThreat assault. That sucks, sure, but turns out it's providing an opportunity for some payback. Those XenoThreat pukes are being led by ~mission(TargetName) who's been on the shit list of my boss for weeks now.

I'm looking for you to head out there and put 'em down.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Shot in the chaos
routes.description:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake ~mission(Location|Address). The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by ~mission(TargetName) and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.description:
Not sure if you've heard but ~mission(Location|Address) is getting hit by XenoThreat. Situation's not good, but under control. Here's the deal though, the assholes attacking are being led by some real trash named ~mission(TargetName). We've dealt with ~mission(TargetName|Last) before and they continually slip away before we can put them down.

That changes. We want you to head there and take out ~mission(TargetName|Last) before they squirm out of this noose.

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure ~mission(TargetName|Last) doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.

We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at ~mission(Location|Address) who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. ~mission(TargetName|Last) is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out ~mission(TargetName|Last), they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Need a scalpel at Carver's
routes.description:

Stows out.

routes.description:

Security there's being run by ~mission(TargetName) and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

routes.locality: Pyro region B (near Bloom and Pyro V L5)

routes.description:

We've dealt with ~mission(TargetName|Last) before and they continually slip away before we can put them down.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: FTL Courier: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN NYX
routes.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
FTL requires an entry-level courier to complete deliveries in Nyx.
Courier must provide own transportation.
Prior training in manual lifting is preferred, with the <EM4>ability to move boxes of up to .25 SCU</EM4> in weight.
By accepting this contract you agree to take full responsibility for the safety of the assigned packages.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

routes.mission_name: FTL Courier: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
routes.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS** 
A reliable and hardworking entry-level courier is needed to ferry a delivery in Stanton.
You will be responsible for providing your own transportation.
Interested contractors need the <EM4>ability to lift up to .25 SCU boxes</EM4>.
Contractors are employed on an independent basis and therefore not covered by FTL's company insurance.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

routes.mission_name: FTL Courier: JR. LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN STANTON
routes.description:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
Junior-level courier needed for deliveries across the Stanton System.
Transportation must be provided by courier.
You will be <EM4>required to lift up to .25 SCU</EM4> in weight.
Couriers are responsible for the correct handling and safety of all packages charged to their care.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Orange Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>~mission(Objects) and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Red Lvl. Contract: Defend ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description: Urgent ship aid needed at ~mission(Location|Address). A band of destructive criminal outlaws that have been trying to make a name for themselves recently has struck hard against one of our high priority clients, attacking their ships and targeting the client's ~mission(Objects). It will be your job to keep everyone and everything safe – though it won't be an easy feat. I cannot stress enough how dangerous these attackers are, so be sure to bring backup to deal with them. If you, the crew, and the infrastructures make it out intact, we’re offering a generous sum of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip to the main contractor. Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Red Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description: An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. If available, we urge you to get to ~mission(Location|Address) as soon as possible. While engaging with the attackers, you'll be expected to protect the client’s ~mission(Objects) and of their ships that may need assistance. This is far from the first we've seen from these particular outlaws, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. If you manage to successfully defend the client's interests, we’re offering ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip as compensation to the main contractor brave enough to take this job on. Stay safe, and good luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Rayari Incorporated: Additional Resources For Research
routes.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Covalex: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
routes.description:
Hi, 

Several Citizens for Prosperity outposts in Pyro need supplies. It seems like we regularly do runs like this for them, but this one looks like it might be a bit riskier. A CFP rep let me know that outlaw activity around these sites has spiked recently, but they desperately need these outposts restocked, so we’re going ahead with the delivery. <EM4>Just a head’s up that you could run into trouble, so come prepared</EM4>.       

All the cargo’s waiting at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and here’s where it’s heading:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)  

According to the manifest, the largest cargo container you’ll need to deal with is <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>. Aside from that, remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.    

~mission(Contractor|SignOff) 
  
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

routes.mission_name: Covalex: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - Direct ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
routes.description:
Hiya, 

Looking for a hauler willing to make a run to Ruin Station. Know hauls to Pyro can give some people pause, but this is one we do regularly to help supply the station. I’ve also confirmed that everything on the cargo manifest is above board. 

If you’re interested, the cargo is ready for pick up at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  Make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Stows out

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. routes.mission_name: Ling Family Hauling: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
routes.description:
Hi,  
 
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.  
 
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.   
 
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of <EM4>~mission(Item)</EM4> that needs to go from <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> to <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.  

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4>, and a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> to move them around. 
 
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.     

 
Sincerely,  
Petra Ling  
Managing Director of Cargo Operations 
Ling Family Hauling 

 

 

 

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Reyes Ling

Ling Family Hauling

routes.mission_name: Rayari Incorporated: Additional Resources For Research
routes.description:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.  

In particular, our scientists at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4> have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Crew Hasn’t Checked In
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In

WORK BRIEF: 
Just got word that one of the mining teams is unaccounted for. They were supposed to be back hours ago, but no one’s heard from them. Family have tried to reach out but haven’t gotten a response from anyone on the crew.

I can send you their last known location, so we’re looking for someone to go check in and see if they’re okay. If the worst happened, <EM4>please identify anyone you find</EM4>. I’m sure the families would appreciate some closure on what happened.

Thanks

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Full Area Scan for Ore
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Full Area Scan For Ore

WORK BRIEF: 
I need you to check something out for me if you’re not busy. I'm looking to build on our mineral database and need some scans of <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4>. I can handle the mining if you want to leave it. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Let me know.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Missing Mining Team
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Mining Team

WORK BRIEF: 
One of our local crews set off for a dig and haven’t checked back in. With everything going on out there, people are starting to get a little worried, so <EM4>we’d like someone to try and get eyes on them</EM4>.

I hate to say this, but if something happened to them, could you <EM4>please identify everyone you find</EM4> so we can let next of kin know?

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Moraine Data Retrieval
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Data Retrieval

WORK BRIEF: 
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to <EM4>infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data</EM4>. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Ore Deposit Needs Scanning
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ore Deposit Needs Scanning

WORK BRIEF: 
I'm looking for an available miner to go out and scan for <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4>. Just need confirmation that it’s there and worth sending someone to collect. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Let me know if you’ve got the time.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Ore Needs Gathering
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ore Needs Gathering

WORK BRIEF: 
Got a big mining job with your name on it. We're looking to update our records about mineral yields so we need someone to scan and extract about <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4> <EM4>~mission(MineableType)</EM4> mined if possible. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Let me know.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Recco Battaglia: Scan And Mining Needed
routes.description:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Scan And Mining Needed

WORK BRIEF: 
I have a job here that might interest you. I need people to go out and do some basic mining in order to pull some geological data for future prospecting. Need someone to scope out and mine <EM4>~mission(Resources)</EM4> <EM4>~mission(MineableType)</EM4>. You'll be helping us out massively. ~mission(Rarity)

Also, if you're stuck or new to mining, there's a <EM4>journal on mining by the United Resource Workers in your mobi</EM4> that you should check out.

Keep me posted.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target takedown for a fast track in
routes.description:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named ~mission(TargetName) who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When ~mission(TargetName|Last) responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to ~mission(Location|Address) and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanna be a Headhunter?
routes.description:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

~mission(TargetName) was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: ~mission(TargetName) needs stomping
routes.description:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So ~mission(TargetName) tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it. 

Last we heard they were spotted around ~mission(Location|Address). We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Simple Hit
routes.description:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. ~mission(TargetName) is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to ~mission(Location|Address) and you should find ~mission(TargetName|Last) flying around. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Target at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around ~mission(Location|Address) that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering ~mission(TargetName) who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that ~mission(TargetName|Last) is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid. 

You know, the usual.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Hit a CFP Ship
routes.description:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named ~mission(TargetName|Last) who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around ~mission(Location|Address). Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Treat yourself to a fight
routes.description:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named ~mission(TargetName) has been spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address).

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Crash some ships
routes.description:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near ~mission(Location|Address) and likely rearming for another attack. 

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Kill Order
routes.description:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to ~mission(TargetName), who's been  driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around ~mission(Location|Address), so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Wanted: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
We got a greenlight to finally take out ~mission(TargetName). They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all. 

We've gotten word that ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying near ~mission(Location|Address) and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Primo Target
routes.description:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. ~mission(TargetName) is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although ~mission(TargetName|Last) might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around ~mission(Location|Address), so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Ghost some XenoTrash
routes.description:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named ~mission(TargetName) who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard ~mission(TargetName|Last) was spotted flying around ~mission(Location|Address), so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Experienced Protection Detail Needed
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of my clients needs an immediate escort through dangerous space. Rendezvous at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and they’ll meet you after they launch. Reports indicate increased outlaw activity in the area, so don’t let your guard down.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: VIP Client Needs Protection
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In need of a contractor who can report in now. A client has found themselves in hot water over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and a protection detail to get away from an asteroid base. They’ve reported multiple, well-armed hostile ships meaning you’ll need a crew of your own to deal with them. Based on the client’s account, these attackers seem highly motivated so they will likely not back down easily.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Protection Detail Needed. High Risk.
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

I’m in need of a highly competent pilot who can gather a crew of equally capable pilots for an escort mission. The mining base at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is currently under attack from a group of outlaws and the crew there is unable to leave without assistance. Our scouts have reported that the attackers are armed with exceptional weaponry and ships.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: Top Tier Operator Needed
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

This contract should only be considered by the most capable of pilots. A highly valued client is currently under attack at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and requires immediate extraction. They’re sitting in the hangar ready to leave, but are unable to move until the hostile ships in the area have been neutralized. 

I don’t see the outlaws stopping any time soon and our client’s reporting they’re packing high-grade weaponry on their ships. This will be a test of your skill as much as your endurance. Assemble whoever you need and head there immediately to assist them.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

routes.mission_name: Red Wind Linehaul: Red Wind Easy Cargo Recovery
routes.description:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

One of our haulers ran into some engine trouble whilst transporting some cargo for us and was forced to abandon their ship. Looking for a contractor who can recover the cargo and complete the delivery. You’ll need to bring your own <EM4>heavy-duty tractor beam</EM4> to transport the cargo to your ship. Details below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
     · <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>

DROP OFF LOCATION
     · Freight elevator at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>

Be advised, the recovery location hasn’t been verified as safe. You might find an opportunistic outlaw trying to take the cargo for themselves, so be on alert.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

routes.description:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: <EM4>~mission(System) </EM4>

TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for a heavy Antium armor set. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.


~mission(Hint_Location) For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine</EM4> in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part <EM4>Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview</EM4> if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Secure ~mission(Location) from Upstarts
routes.description:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
 
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for the main contractor.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: InterSec Defense Solutions: Strategic Bombing
routes.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System 
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing: 
Local assets have indicated that Shattered Blade elements are attempting to rebuild one of their stations and Intersec is looking for a pilot to make sure that doesn't happen.

They've managed to get basic turret defenses back online but currently only have <EM4>two power relays activated</EM4>. These will be your targets as they <EM4>cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, you will need to bring ballistic or ordnance to be effective</EM4>. 

Reactivation of this station will allow the Shattered Blade to try and reclaim a foothold in this system and we can't let that happen.

Good luck,   

Deacon Tobin 
Operations Manager 
InterSec Defense Solutions

Hostile Forces: Vanduul

Join us. Do your part.

routes.description:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been tracking increased outlaw activity in certain sectors of the system. This activity in conjunction with other intelligence leads us to believe that outlaws are planning an attack on elements traveling from the UEE. We're aiming to patrol these sectors and disrupt any plans before they can be put into action.

Currently, we need someone who can help patrol a highly dangerous sector. Once you've accepted the mission, you can proceed to the <EM4>location marker</EM4> on your HUD. Hostile Forces: Vanduul

InterSec has identified a sector that has seen an uptick in Vanduul activity and are looking for someone to patrol the region and provide an update on it.

You'll begin your patrol at a <EM4>location marker</EM4> sent to your HUD and then scan a series of waypoints along a designated route. The Vanduul ships in this sector are highly skilled and aggressive, so InterSec highly recommends that you <EM4>bring several combat-ready ships along as backup</EM4>.

InterSec understands the immense danger you'll be under on this patrol, so we'll send a special bonus of <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor once the sector is clear.

It is clear that they will not stop attempting to spread their hatred unless we stop them.

Join us. Do your part.

routes.mission_name: Crusader Industries: Orison Relief: Large Fabrication Order
routes.description:
Alright,

The damage reports are still rolling in from the Nine Tails' attack on Orison and the folks at Crusader are saying they might have to repair a significant proportion of the propulsors on those platforms. That's why this one's a massive order.

Larger quantity, but same as before otherwise. Either manufacturer them yourself using an Item Fabricator or source them some other way.

When you're done, drop the propulsors off at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Target|Address)</EM4>. Be a big payout with this one.

Ta very much,
Hal Grimsby
Contracts Manager

CORNERSTONE DEVELOPMENTS
"Building on the Foundations of our Past."

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Orange Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>~mission(Objects) and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Red Lvl. Contract: Defend ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description: Urgent ship aid needed at ~mission(Location|Address). A band of destructive criminal outlaws that have been trying to make a name for themselves recently has struck hard against one of our high priority clients, attacking their ships and targeting the client's ~mission(Objects). It will be your job to keep everyone and everything safe – though it won't be an easy feat. I cannot stress enough how dangerous these attackers are, so be sure to bring backup to deal with them. If you, the crew, and the infrastructures make it out intact, we’re offering a generous sum of ~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip to the main contractor. Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.description: An emergency SOS just came through from a maintenance crew under the employ of one of Foxwell's VIP clients. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site. routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Keep ~mission(Location) Safe
routes.description:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4>. It won't stand.   

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including <EM4>any friendly ships</EM4> in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.

routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

Another day another beacon. There's a <EM4>~mission(Ship)</EM4> looking to be topped up with ~mission(FuelType) at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  The client vessel will pay you at the rate of ~mission(RefuelRequest), and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

routes.mission_name: Adagio Holdings: Adagio Holdings in Need of Salvagers
routes.description:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer

> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.

> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.

This introductory contract will require you to head to <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.

Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at <EM4>~mission(Destination|Address)</EM4>.

> Requirements <
     - Any class/size of salvage ship

For advice on salvaging, consult <EM4>A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection</EM4> in your mobiGlas journal.

> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

routes.description:
A senior security official by the name of ~mission(TargetName) is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at ~mission(Location|Address), they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.  

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter. 

Earnestly,
Vaughn

Earnestly,
Vaughn

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Your assistance will be critical to our success,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eliminate Fuel Stores
routes.description:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community. 

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions. 

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Halt Narcotics Operation
routes.description:
Citizens for Prosperity has been working hard to improve people's lives across the system, but an already difficult task becomes near impossible when drugs get involved. We've recently seen a dealer specifically targeting our most vulnerable and have experienced setbacks across the board. This needs to stop.

We would like you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and put a permanent end to their production line.

Do this and we can hopefully get our people back on track. 
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
routes.description:
There is a group of outlaws at ~mission(Location|Address) that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system. 

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves. 

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Eradicate All Traces of Headhunter Data
routes.description:
We're just putting the full picture together now, but so far we've learned that a Headhunter by the name of ~mission(TargetName) recently stole some sensitive data that if exposed will be detrimental to Citizens for Prosperity's cause. 

We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at ~mission(Location|Address) as well as tracking down ~mission(TargetName|Last) to stop them from further disseminating the information.

Your help is much appreciated,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Disable Outlaw Stronghold at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
Following a series of raids against Citizens for Prosperity aligned settlements, we believe we have traced those responsible back to ~mission(Location|Address).

Attacking them directly will pose too great of a risk and most likely encourage aggressive reprisals. Instead, we believe that if their power generators were to be disable it could force them to settle somewhere else.

Do you think you could handle it for us?
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
routes.description:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to ~mission(Location|Address) and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Take Headhunter Stronghold Offline
routes.description:
With the recent aggression perpetrated by the Headhunters against our people, Citizens for Prosperity has been arranging a full operation that should hopefully deal them a significant blow. 

However, before that can happen, we need to by some more time to finish our preparations. If you could destroy the power generators at ~mission(Location|Address) it should stall the Headhunters long enough for us to ready our counter attack. 

Your assistance will be critical to our success,
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
routes.locality: Pyro region C (near Pyro IV and Pyro V)

routes.mission_name: Citizens For Prosperity: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
routes.description:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system. 

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at ~mission(Location|Address).

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.
 
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher

routes.mission_name: Covalex: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
routes.description:
Hi, 

Several Citizens for Prosperity outposts in Pyro need supplies. It seems like we regularly do runs like this for them, but this one looks like it might be a bit riskier. A CFP rep let me know that outlaw activity around these sites has spiked recently, but they desperately need these outposts restocked, so we’re going ahead with the delivery. <EM4>Just a head’s up that you could run into trouble, so come prepared</EM4>.       

All the cargo’s waiting at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> and here’s where it’s heading:  

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER) 

~mission(SingleToMultiToken)  

According to the manifest, the largest cargo container you’ll need to deal with is <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize)</EM4>. Aside from that, remember to bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> along.    

~mission(Contractor|SignOff) 
  
Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

routes.mission_name: Covalex: ~mission(ReputationRank) Rank - Direct ~mission(CargoGradeToken) Cargo Haul
routes.description:
Hiya, 

Looking for a hauler willing to make a run to Ruin Station. Know hauls to Pyro can give some people pause, but this is one we do regularly to help supply the station. I’ve also confirmed that everything on the cargo manifest is above board. 

If you’re interested, the cargo is ready for pick up at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>.  Make sure you bring a <EM4>handheld tractor beam</EM4> and a ship that can hold <EM4>~mission(MissionMaxSCUSize) cargo containers</EM4> otherwise it might be a little rough.

~mission(Contractor|SignOff)

Ella Tieno 
Jr. Logistics Coordinator 
Covalex Shipping   
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.' 







Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

routes.mission_name: Eckhart Security: High-Risk Bounty: ~mission(TargetName)
routes.description:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = ~mission(ApprovalCode)

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

We’ve received actionable intelligence on a dangerous bounty, who’s turned out to be extremely elusive. <EM4>~mission(TargetName)</EM4> was spotted with a dedicated contingent of known associates at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. We’re looking for a contractor ready and willing to execute this bounty before they disappear again.

Based on previous attempts to apprehend this criminal, there’s a good chance that <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> will try to avoid a direct confrontation, and instead send their allies to confront you. We believe that neutralizing these protective forces, and shredding the safety net they provide, is the best way to draw out <EM4>~mission(TargetName|Last)</EM4> to face you directly. 

Expect to confront a significant and skilled force. We advise that you plan accordingly. Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

routes.mission_name: Foxwell Enforcement: Orange Lvl. Contract: Protect ~mission(Objects) and Escort Employees
routes.description:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the <EM4>~mission(Objects) and ships</EM4> in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage. 

If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) MG Scrip</EM4> to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully. 

Best of luck,

Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Guard ~mission(Location) From Rivals
routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

routes.description:
The maintenance and reliable function of <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there. 

Protecting the site, and any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4>, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some <EM4>reliable backup along</EM4> when you go and terminate these nullbrains. 

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow
routes.locality: Pyro region A (near Pyro I, Monox, and Bloom L3-L5)

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Stop Rival Attack at ~mission(Location)
routes.description:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4>. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the <EM4>~mission(Objects)</EM4> there.

I need you and whatever <EM4>crew you can muster</EM4> on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor  <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4>.

- Stows

routes.mission_name: Headhunters: Defend ~mission(Location) From Mercs
routes.description:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a <EM4>crew of your own</EM4> to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> for a job well done. 

Stows out.
